headline: Relief rally after Democrats win Congress: VIX down 20%, 10-yr yield off 5bp, softer dollar.
brief: Nasdaq rose about 1.4% as midterm results eased uncertainty, though it closed in the lower third of its range after fading from the high. Tonight's Asia session digests after-hours results from Qualcomm, Arm and AppLovin plus a sharp drop in oil. The key risk is renewed selling in AI data center and chip names, which weighed on Asian chip stocks on Wednesday.

sources.title: CNN: Dow best post-midterm day in 44 years
Yahoo Finance: Wall Street ends higher after Democrats win Congress
